title: 🌿✨ Reflecting on Redemption: A Blessed Day at Weegols Garden ✨🌿
paragraphs: 🌿✨ Reflecting on Redemption: A Blessed Day at Weegols Garden ✨🌿

Gratitude fills my heart today as I look back on a truly special Bible study session at Weegols Garden with the incredible staff and employees. Our time together was a powerful reminder of the love and sacrifice of Jesus Christ, and I'm immensely thankful for the support of two remarkable individuals: Jeremiah Calo and Dr. Edward Chan.
🙏 The Message of Redemption 🙏
In the midst of the picturesque beauty of Weegols Garden, we delved into the profound topic of how Jesus Christ paid for our sins and reconciled us with our Heavenly Father.

Together, we explored the Garden of Gethsemane, where Jesus agonized in prayer before His crucifixion, and we marveled at the depth of His love and sacrifice for us. It's a message that reminds us of our worthiness in the eyes of our Father, not because of our deeds but because of the grace of our Savior.
🌟 A Kingdom Assignment and Gratitude 🌟

I want to extend my heartfelt thanks to my cousin Jeremiah Calo for his unwavering support and for graciously allowing us to use the venue and his dedicated employees to be part of this Kingdom Assignment. Your generosity and kindness have made this gathering possible, and I'm deeply grateful.

To my Bro. Mayor Dr. Edward Chan, your understanding and support have been a source of strength throughout this journey. May God bless you both abundantly as you continue to extend your helping hands to others and make a positive impact in the lives of many.
🙌 A Prayer for Abundant Blessings 🙌

As we part ways today, I offer a prayer for God to continue showering Jeremiah Calo and Edward Chan with abundant blessings, and may they be vessels of His love, hope, and transformation to those they encounter.
With heartfelt gratitude and blessings,
Bro. John Asis  🌿🙏 #WeegolsGardenBibleStudy #RedemptionInChrist #Gratitude #biblestudy #CellGroup #KingdomAssignment
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: Yesterday, i felt loved not only by GOD but also by families and thousands of friends that greeted me and wish me well on my birthday!
paragraphs: Yesterday, i felt loved not only by GOD but also by families and thousands of friends that  greeted me and wish me well on my birthday!
Last year was full of challenges and suffering, but it was all a test and a process to make me mature and mold me to be a better version of me.

i thank God for always there for me, and to my wife Asis Pinky who stick with me even in my lowest moment of my life,  and especially to all my families and friends who never abandoned me... thank you so much.

GOD is faithful to His promises. when you will be awakened to the what really is your purpose, God will continue to aligned you and mold you to be the person He wants you to be... then GOD will assign you to where He wants you to be.... Thank you God for using some people to be your instrument to align me, i thank you for the life of Pastor Rey Sanico  and Pastora Cecile Sanico  that you used to pull me back towards you and helped in molding who i am today. Thank you God for your vision, truly you are faithful and used people  so i can fulfill my assignments towards your kingdom. Thank you for the people that you used... and thank you for all the friends that continue to support me. Trully, You ARE AN AMAZING AND FAITHFUL GOD.!
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: Peace I leave with you; my peace I give to you. Not as the world gives do I give to you. Let not your hearts be troubled, neither let them be afraid. - John 14:27
paragraphs: Peace I leave with you; my peace I give to you. Not as the world gives do I give to you. Let not your hearts be troubled, neither let them be afraid.  - John 14:27

Just finish the Bible Study and cellgroup here at Weegol's Garden... we are few today but nevertheless, we continue with our session for the topic are very important for them to learn...  "Guarding Your Heart"

Many of the sins started because of we thought it is just a minor negative feelings, but these minor feelings like pride, jealousy, anger and many more can cause devastation and destroy lives, families and even nations... that is why guarding our hearts is very important.

Again, thank you my cousin Jeremiah Betia Calo for letting me use your venue and your staff to be part of my mission in advancing the kingdom of GOD, may He forever flourish you with abundant blessings in your life..... and thank you my brother Mayor Edward U. Chan for your unending support and understanding for letting me continue my assignments in advancing Gods Kingdom... may you also have the blessings and guidance of GOD be upon you and your businesses as you continue to help others.
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what God’s will is—his good, pleasing and perfect will. - Romans 12:2
paragraphs: Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what God’s will is—his good, pleasing and perfect will. - Romans 12:2

These young men and women are now truly being transformed by GOD for His kingdom. As week and more weeks passed by, i am witnessing big transformation and growth not only on their attitudes but also in character as well. happy to see them grow in Christ Jesus teachings.

Thanks again my cousin Jeremiah Betia Calo for letting your staff and venue be used for the advancement of GOD's kingdom, your never ending support is astounding and giving us hope towards godliness, may GOD bless you abundantly for your generosity.

and to my bro Mayor Doctor Edward U. Chan , thanks again for your understanding and support, your big heart to help others is a rare virtue to behold, Thanks again, and may GOD continue to pour out blessings on your businesses and endeavors on helping the people and community.
